newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks close 2.23 pct down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks close 2.23 pct down.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed 2.23 percent lower on Monday owing to political uncertainty before the February 3 general elections, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index closed 30.73 points, or 2.23 percent, lower at 1,344.82. Losers led gainers 203 to 40 in a provisional turnover of 11 million shares, compared to 24 million on Tuesday. The market was closed from Wednesday to Sunday owing to holidays.
PTCL plunged 1.45 rupees to 25.75, HUBCO 1.05 to 31.40 and ICI Pakistan 0.95 to 17.40. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
